verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that a pricing page exists at getunleash.io/pricing, but every quoted item from it is a plan feature (SSO, RBAC, export/import, stale-flag dashboard). Nothing shows actual prices or what drives cost, such as seats, MAUs, events or requests. Feature-tier lists are adjacent material and do not show published pricing or cost drivers.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
